headline: Witkoff–Putin St. Petersburg meeting outcome
dek: Putin met Witkoff at Constantine Palace, St. Petersburg (his 9th in-person encounter).
sources: Reuters (Russian news agencies Interfax/TASS); Zelenskyy via Fox News
fault_line: 'Ukraine has to want to settle' — who is blocking the end of this war? Diesel-deal + sanctions-waiver pushback gives the debate-bait layer.

sections.what_happened: Putin met Witkoff at Constantine Palace, St. Petersburg (his 9th in-person encounter). Putin thanked Trump, said Russia wants economic ties restored. Witkoff: 'basis for a ceasefire', hopes Putin considers resuming Russia-US-Ukraine trilateral talks; brought written documents; Jared Kushner joined by phone. Putin offered to help resolve the Iran conflict. Zelenskyy (Fox & Friends): hopes for a 'positive' result 'in hours', supports trilateral talks ('important to negotiate trilaterally'), thanked US for restored intel sharing, hopes Starlink limitations lifted.
sections.what_verified: Reuters 09:21 UTC (985theriver, reuters.com); sfg.media TASS relay adds Hubbard release detail, diesel/fertilizer quotes, Putin Iran-mediation offer; Zelenskyy Fox interview via Reuters <1h crawl; Straits Times Oslo context (early-warning system restored, Starlink, Article 5-like guarantees).
sections.what_disputed: Oslo talks (Oct 20) produced no confirmed ceasefire agreement (Outlook India). Zelenskyy: Putin said 'no' to energy ceasefire (1500-05). Trump's 'Ukraine has to want to settle' frames pressure on Kyiv, not Moscow concessions. Putin's 'thanks' is diplomatic theater — no commitment quoted.
sections.why_matters: Map-of-pressure: Witkoff shuttles Oslo->St. Petersburg with Trump's written proposals; Zelenskyy publicly begs for trilateral on Fox; Putin banks goodwill (Hubbard release, diesel, Iran offer) without committing. Honest label: 'basis for a ceasefire' is Witkoff's claim, not Moscow's commitment.
sections.context: Background: Witkoff–Putin St. Petersburg meeting outcome — 'basis for a ceasefire', trilateral-talks hope; Zelenskyy on Fox: supports trilateral; Putin offers Iran mediation

totw_analysis: Our read: Map-of-pressure: Witkoff shuttles Oslo->St. Petersburg with Trump's written proposals; Zelenskyy publicly begs for trilateral on Fox; Putin banks goodwill (Hubbard release, diesel, Iran offer) without committing. Honest label: 'basis for a ceasefire' is Witkoff's claim, not Moscow's commitment. The fault line our audience is arguing over: 'Ukraine has to want to settle' — who is blocking the end of this war? Diesel-deal + sanctions-waiver pushback gives the debate-bait layer.
